Avery Kim: Quick heads-up: previewing 'snapshot-provenance' for Private/VPC. Lightweight feature to embed provenance metadata and a signed chain for GA snapshots used in audits. :scroll:
Avery Kim: Why: auditors want an easy way to verify that a config/model snapshot wasn't tampered with between creation and export. This adds a simple chain of custody for bundles.
Rohit Banerjee: How it behaves: when a snapshot is created we emit a provenance record (creator, time, agent-hash, parent-snapshot id) and sign it with the tenant signing key. Each export appends an export-event entry. The final bundle contains the chain.
Avery Kim: Quick CLI to create + fetch id:
redwoodctl private snapshot create --tenant t-404 --reason "audit"
redwoodctl private snapshot fetch --tenant t-404 --id sp-20260401
Security: Signing options: Redwood-managed, customer-supplied HSM, or offline key. For air-gapped installs we support offline signatures and a detachable proof file customers can bring to auditors.
Product Ops: Rollout plan: canary pk-staging-8 tomorrow 09:00 PT, limited preview to invited customers in 2 weeks, GA after compliance review. Preview invites + runbook go out tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Rohit Banerjee: SRE note: exporters will add X-Snapshot-Provenance header on successful upload. Add a check in release runner to ignore provenance headers when comparing bundles.
